_meta.description: Geographic zones covering the whole Bali province. Every spot has one `region` from this list.
_meta.note: Regions are NOT the same as stay-areas.json. A region is where a place IS; a stay area is where a visitor SLEEPS. Many curated spots (Jatiluwih, Sekumpul, Besakih) sit far from any stay area, so regions must be a separate, broader set.

regions.label: South Bali
regions.blurb: Canggu, Seminyak, Sanur and Denpasar — the busy, beachy heart.

regions.label: Bukit Peninsula
regions.blurb: Limestone cliffs, hidden coves and the island's best sunsets.

regions.label: Ubud & Central Bali
regions.blurb: Rice terraces, river gorges, temples and the arts scene.

regions.label: East Bali
regions.blurb: Sidemen, Amed and Karangasem — water palaces under Mount Agung.

regions.label: North Bali & Highlands
regions.blurb: Bedugul lakes, Munduk waterfalls and the quiet Lovina coast.

regions.label: West Bali
regions.blurb: Tabanan's rice country, sea temples and the national park.

regions.label: Nusa Islands
regions.blurb: Penida and Lembongan — reached by fast boat, worth the crossing.
